4. H sits second to the left of G.

questions.prompt: Who sits third to the right of H?

steps: Start with clues 1, 4, 3 and 2: together they fix E, G, H, K and F.
J takes the only seat left.
Final arrangement (west to east): K, F, H, J, G, E.
Third to the right of H: J → G → E — answer **E**.
solution.shortcut: Take left/right from the person’s own facing, then count seats along the row.

questions.prompt: Who sit at the extreme ends of the row?

J takes the only seat left.

Between H and E sit 2 persons — **Two**.

solution.trap: Three comes from counting one of the two named persons.

set.subject: reasoning
set.title: Linear seating
set.stimulus:
Six persons, H, J, K, L, M and N, sit in a straight row facing south, not necessarily in the same order. Left and right are taken from each person's own point of view.

1. N sits third to the left of M.
2. J sits second to the right of M.
3. M sits second to the right of H.
4. Only two persons sit between L and H.
5. N sits at the extreme left end of the row.

questions.subject: reasoning
questions.prompt: Who sits to the immediate right of M?

steps: Start with clues 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5: together they fix M, N, J, H and L.
K takes the only seat left.
Final arrangement (west to east): J, L, M, K, H, N.
M faces south, so M's right is towards the west end.
Immediately to the right of M: L — answer **L**.
solution.shortcut: Take left/right from the person’s own facing, then count seats along the row.
solution.trap: K is immediately to the left — counting in the wrong direction gives this option.

steps: Start with clues 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5: together they fix M, N, J, H and L.

N faces south, so N's right is towards the west end.
